_what: Frozen Phase 2 decision and protocol, computed from the REAL London Bakers workbook. Committed BEFORE the sealed hold-out is read, so the hold-out is a single confirmatory run and not another round of selection. Nothing here may be edited after 2026-09-29..2026-10-05 is scored.

dataProvenance.inputGuards: scripts/validation/forecastBacktest.js --data-kind real aborts unless rows < 50000, the span lies within 2026-09-01..2026-10-05 and distinct days <= 35; --end-date is refused on real data
dataProvenance.notAccuracyEvidence: docs/validation/forecast_results_synthetic.md and frozen_config_synthetic_superseded.json came from London_Bakers_Dataset.xlsx, an extrapolated 731-day series, and are superseded

productionEngine.reason: Holt-Winters scored 44.55% pooled dev WAPE against velocity's 31.48% and lost in 7 of 7 folds. Paired per-SKU-day difference +1.554 units, 95% block-bootstrap CI [1.259, 1.756] — reliably worse. It is not switched on.

winner.label: store weekday profile x SKU level
winner.note: Lowest pooled dev WAPE (30.82%) and reliably better than M1 seasonal naive, but it exists only in scripts/validation/forecastBacktest.js and its edge over velocity is NOT reliable (CI straddles 0). Recorded as a Phase 5 candidate; nothing in src/ was changed for it.

config.level: mean of the SKU's own training days
config.weekdayIndex: mean store-wide units per weekday over the same training days, divided by the mean across all days
config.forecast: level x weekdayIndex for the projected day's weekday, clipped at 0

diagnosis.reading: The grid sits on its own boundary (alpha = 0.1 in 66% of fits, beta = 0 in 74%) and has one pass over the data after initialisation; the result tracks seasonal naive (44.55 vs 45.71) rather than a seasonal model.

bootstrap.method: block bootstrap by calendar day: 7 scored days resampled with replacement, observations pooled per draw, estimator matched to the observation-weighted point estimate
bootstrap.caveat: 7 resampling units — the interval is coarse and indicative, not exact

protocol.selectionRule: Pick the method with the lowest pooled WAPE over the 7 expanding-window dev folds. Accept it only if its paired per-SKU-day absolute error minus M1 seasonal naive has a 95% block-bootstrap interval (calendar-day blocks) entirely below 0. Otherwise record 'no reliable improvement' and keep FORECAST_ENGINE = velocity. No preset, window or parameter is changed after these numbers are seen.
protocol.engineChangeRule: An engine change additionally requires the winner to be an implemented engine (velocity | holt_winters) AND to reliably beat the engine shipping today.

weekdayPattern.source: SUM of units per day over the 28 dev days (sealed week excluded before aggregation)
weekdayPattern.caveat: 35 days is 5 observations per weekday (4 in the dev window): wide uncertainty, context only
